title: Algorithmically generated / high-entropy DNS domains (DGA indicators)
message_template: {distinct} distinct high-entropy DNS queries from {entity} within {window_seconds}s
notes: Entropy is computed deterministically from the first DNS label (Shannon bits/char, ≥3.2 with length ≥16 = high). CDN/telemetry noise is possible; combine with threat intel and domain age in later phases.
